# mapping
```{r}
# helper
map_ensembl_to_entrez <- function(x) {

  x <- sub("\\..*$", "", x)

  mapped <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys = unique(x),
    keytype = "ENSEMBL",
    columns = c("ENTREZID", "SYMBOL")
  ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(ENTREZID),
      !is.na(SYMBOL)
    ) %>%
    distinct(ENSEMBL, .keep_all = TRUE)

  mapped
}

# selected
ileum_selected_map <- map_ensembl_to_entrez(
  unique(ileum_lasso$gene)
)

colon_selected_map <- map_ensembl_to_entrez(
  unique(colon_lasso$gene)
)

# universe
ileum_universe_map <- map_ensembl_to_entrez(
  ileum_universe_ens
)

colon_universe_map <- map_ensembl_to_entrez(
  colon_universe_ens
)


cat(
  "Ileum selected:",
  length(unique(ileum_lasso$gene)),

)
```

## giveup cnetpot and use other plot
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)

make_pathway_gene_df <- function(enrich_obj, top_n = 5) {

  top_df <- as.data.frame(enrich_obj) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(p.adjust) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    dplyr::select(Description, p.adjust, geneID)

  edges <- top_df %>%
    separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/") %>%
    dplyr::rename(entrez = geneID)

  gene_map <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys = unique(edges$entrez),
    keytype = "ENTREZID",
    columns = "SYMBOL"
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(SYMBOL)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(ENTREZID, .keep_all = TRUE)

  edges %>%
    left_join(
      gene_map,
      by = c("entrez" = "ENTREZID")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(SYMBOL)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Description = stringr::str_wrap(Description, width = 25)
    )
}
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(igraph)
library(ggrepel)
library(stringr)

make_lasso_network <- function(edge_df, site_title, seed = 123) {

  # clean labels
  edge_plot <- edge_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Description = str_replace_all(Description, "\n", " "),
      Description = str_wrap(Description, width = 24),
      pathway_id = paste0("PATH_", row_number())
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(Description, p.adjust, SYMBOL) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()

  # prefix IDs so pathway/gene names can never collide
  graph_edges <- edge_plot %>%
    transmute(
      from = paste0("P::", Description),
      to   = paste0("G::", SYMBOL),
      pathway = Description
    )

  pathway_vertices <- edge_plot %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Description, p.adjust) %>%
    transmute(
      name = paste0("P::", Description),
      label = Description,
      type = "Pathway",
      p.adjust = p.adjust
    )

  gene_vertices <- edge_plot %>%
    dplyr::distinct(SYMBOL) %>%
    transmute(
      name = paste0("G::", SYMBOL),
      label = SYMBOL,
      type = "Gene",
      p.adjust = NA_real_
    )

  vertices <- bind_rows(pathway_vertices, gene_vertices)

  # construct graph
  g <- graph_from_data_frame(
    graph_edges,
    directed = FALSE,
    vertices = vertices
  )

  # layout only -- avoids ggraph/cnetplot error
  set.seed(seed)

  lay <- layout_with_fr(
    g,
    niter = 3000,
    grid = "nogrid"
  )

  node_df <- as.data.frame(lay)
  colnames(node_df) <- c("x", "y")

  node_df$name <- V(g)$name

  node_df <- node_df %>%
    left_join(vertices, by = "name")

  # edge coordinates
  edge_coords <- graph_edges %>%
    left_join(
      node_df %>% dplyr::select(name, x, y),
      by = c("from" = "name")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(x_from = x, y_from = y) %>%
    left_join(
      node_df %>% dplyr::select(name, x, y),
      by = c("to" = "name")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(x_to = x, y_to = y)

  pathway_nodes <- node_df %>%
    filter(type == "Pathway")

  gene_nodes <- node_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(type == "Gene")

  p <- ggplot() +

    # pathway-gene edges
    geom_segment(
      data = edge_coords,
      aes(
        x = x_from,
        y = y_from,
        xend = x_to,
        yend = y_to,
        color = pathway
      ),
      linewidth = 0.55,
      alpha = 0.55
    ) +

    # gene nodes
    geom_point(
      data = gene_nodes,
      aes(x = x, y = y),
      size = 3.2,
      color = "grey60"
    ) +

    # pathway nodes
    geom_point(
      data = pathway_nodes,
      aes(x = x, y = y, color = label),
      size = 5
    ) +

    # gene labels
    geom_text_repel(
      data = gene_nodes,
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
      size = 5,
      box.padding = 0.25,
      point.padding = 0.15,
      segment.color = NA,
      max.overlaps = Inf
    ) +

    # pathway labels
    geom_text_repel(
      data = pathway_nodes,
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
      size = 6,
      fontface = "bold",
      box.padding = 0.4,
      point.padding = 0.3,
      segment.color = NA,
      max.overlaps = Inf
    ) +

    labs(
      title = site_title,
      color = "Pathway"
    ) +

    theme_void(base_size = 15) +

    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5,
        size = 14
      ),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 13),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      plot.margin = margin(15, 25, 15, 25)
    )

  return(p)
}
```

# panel e
```{r}
ileum_top <- read.csv("/Users/guokexin/Documents/allenlee/manuscript/revision_072726/lasso_revision/lasso_ileum_top_stable_features.csv")
colon_top <- read.csv("/Users/guokexin/Documents/allenlee/manuscript/revision_072726/lasso_revision/lasso_colon_top_stable_features.csv")

all_top <- bind_rows(ileum_top, colon_top)
```
```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Standardize site labels + clean gene IDs
# ------------------------------------------------------------

all_top <- all_top %>%
  mutate(
    site = case_when(
      str_detect(site, regex("ileum", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Ileum",
      str_detect(site, regex("colon|rectosigmoid|left", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~
        "Rectosigmoid Colon",
      TRUE ~ site
    ),

    # remove Ensembl version suffix if present
    gene_clean = sub("\\..*$", "", gene),

    abs_beta = abs(beta),

    direction = if_else(
      beta >= 0,
      "Positive",
      "Negative"
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Map Ensembl gene IDs -> gene symbols
# ------------------------------------------------------------

gene_map <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = unique(all_top$gene_clean),
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  columns = c("SYMBOL")
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SYMBOL)) %>%
  distinct(ENSEMBL, .keep_all = TRUE)

all_top <- all_top %>%
  left_join(
    gene_map,
    by = c("gene_clean" = "ENSEMBL")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # fallback to Ensembl if symbol mapping fails
    SYMBOL = if_else(
      is.na(SYMBOL) | SYMBOL == "",
      NA,
      SYMBOL
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Select objectively displayed pairs
#
# Rule:
# - prioritize higher selection frequency
# - break ties by larger absolute coefficient
# - max 2 pairs per microbe
# - show 8 pairs per site
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pick_top_stable_pairs <- function(df,
                                  n_keep = 8,
                                  max_per_microbe = 2) {

  df <- df %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(beta),
      !is.na(selection_frequency),
      !is.na(microbe),
      !is.na(SYMBOL)
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      desc(selection_frequency),
      desc(abs_beta)
    )

  selected_idx <- integer(0)
  microbe_count <- c()

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {

    this_microbe <- df$microbe[i]

    n_this <- if (
      this_microbe %in% names(microbe_count)
    ) {
      microbe_count[[this_microbe]]
    } else {
      0
    }

    if (n_this < max_per_microbe) {

      selected_idx <- c(selected_idx, i)

      microbe_count[[this_microbe]] <- n_this + 1
    }

    if (length(selected_idx) >= n_keep) {
      break
    }
  }

  df[selected_idx, , drop = FALSE]
}

plot_df <- all_top %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  group_modify(
    ~ pick_top_stable_pairs(
      .x,
      n_keep = 6,
      max_per_microbe = 2
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Create readable gene-microbe labels
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    microbe_label = str_replace_all(microbe, "_", " "),

    pair_label = paste0(
      SYMBOL,
      "\n(",
      microbe_label,
      ")"
    )
  )

# inspect exactly which pairs will be displayed
plot_df %>%
  dplyr::select(
    site,
    SYMBOL,
    microbe,
    beta,
    selection_frequency
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    site,
    desc(selection_frequency),
    desc(abs(beta))
  )
```
```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Control y-axis ordering within each site
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  arrange(abs_beta, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    pair_plot = factor(
      pair_label,
      levels = unique(pair_label)
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Revised forest-like Panel E
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pE <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = beta,
    y = pair_plot,
    color = direction
  )
) +

  # zero reference
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey40",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  # forest/lollipop-style line from zero to coefficient
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = 0,
      xend = beta,
      y = pair_plot,
      yend = pair_plot
    ),
    linewidth = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +

  # point size communicates reviewer-requested stability
  geom_point(
    aes(size = selection_frequency),
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~ site,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol = 2
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Negative" = "#2C7FB8",
      "Positive" = "#D7301F"
    ),
    name = "Coefficient direction"
  ) +

  scale_size_continuous(
    name = "Selection frequency",
    range = c(2.8, 7),
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "LASSO coefficient",
    y = "Gene–microbe pair"
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +

  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 13
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13),

    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),

    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11),

    legend.position = "top",

    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),

    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),

    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

    panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines")
  )

pE
```

```{r}
pick_top_stable_pairs <- function(df,
                                  n_keep = 8,
                                  max_per_microbe = 2) {

  df <- df %>%
    arrange(desc(selection_frequency), desc(abs_beta))

  selected_idx <- integer(0)
  microbe_count <- c()

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {

    this_microbe <- df$microbe[i]

    n_this <- if (
      this_microbe %in% names(microbe_count)
    ) {
      microbe_count[[this_microbe]]
    } else {
      0
    }

    if (n_this < max_per_microbe) {
      selected_idx <- c(selected_idx, i)
      microbe_count[[this_microbe]] <- n_this + 1
    }

    if (length(selected_idx) >= n_keep) break
  }

  df[selected_idx, , drop = FALSE]
}
```
